scope: Suspension load specification and body-interface dimensional audit; not complete truck fabrication drawings
units: mm, N, kg, Hz unless noted

mass_provenance.status: Inherited allocations, not weighed or rated

frame_provenance.status: GLOBAL COORDINATION STUDY — NOT SELECTED; NOT FOR FABRICATION OR CONSTRUCTION

architecture: Develop guided primary coil suspension, with springs between axlebox saddles and bogie frame; body supported through a separately retained center-bearing/pivot and controlled sidebearers. Equalization and secondary suspension remain alternatives pending twist/ride analysis.
spring_count_basis: Two coils per axlebox, four axleboxes per truck, for this calculation only; not a final hardware selection.
unsprung_mass_definition: Wheelsets, axleboxes and all brake/carrier mass that moves with the axleboxes. Include effective participating spring mass in refined dynamics. These trial masses are not a verified range.
frequency_status: Analyst-selected sensitivity points, not a comfort standard or approved target.
limitations: Uniform loading and equal spring rates; vertical heave only; no roll, pitch, yaw, track twist, friction, damping, load redistribution or resonance acceptance.
Upper mass cases are design screens, not normal operating passenger loads.
Do not subtract only unsprung mass to calculate the body center-bearing force: the complete truck mass must be removed for that interface.
The existing 32-inch floor reference has no accepted load state. Loaded/empty operating floor heights remain to be fixed.

references: Rimutaka locomotive chassis and cab CAD screenshot
forbidden_inferences: Do not import wheel profiles, spring arrangement, dimensions, material or load ratings.
Do not select spoked coach wheels because the example shows spokes.
owner_visual_reference.required_output: Recognizable assembled 3D truck and coordinated dimensioned orthographic, section and mounting/part drawings from the same supported geometry. Show purchased brakes only in train-installation context; no standalone drum-internals teardown.
